svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Software Architect roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Architecture Basics: The architect's role, Quality attributes, Trade-off analysis, Architecture decision records, Diagrams with the C4 model, Architecture documentation; 02 System Design: Requirements and capacity estimates, Monoliths and microservices, Caching, Scaling, Background jobs and queues; 03 API and Integration Architecture: API contracts and versioning, Calls and messages, Messaging and events, Integration patterns, Backward compatibility; 04 Data Architecture: Data modelling, Choosing data stores, Schema migrations, Transactions and consistency, Retention and backups, Reporting and analytics; 05 Reliability and Performance: Service level objectives, Failure handling, Performance and load testing, Observability, Disaster recovery; 06 Security and Privacy Architecture: Threat modelling, Identity and access, Secrets and key management, Secure design review, Privacy by design, Supply chain security; 07 Cloud and Cost: Cloud architecture frameworks, Containers and orchestration, Infrastructure as code, Cost estimation, Environments and deployment; 08 AI-Enabled Systems: Where AI fits in a system, Retrieval and data access, Evaluations and guardrails, AI cost and latency, AI security and governance; 09 Modernization and Migration: Assessing legacy systems, Choosing a modernization path, Strangler fig, Data migration, Cutover and rollback; 10 Architecture Practice: Architecture reviews, Explaining decisions to stakeholders, Estimates and proposals, Reference architectures and standards, Mentoring, Fitness functions
svg.text: Where AI fits in a system
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
